title: Vanilla: Remixed
description: A refreshment for people that are tired of Vanilla
body:
![A logo of the modpack, Vanilla: Remixed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8651109d29fae69d415469c30ca3466f2a112309.png)

A modpack that's made for and by people that have gotten bored of the vanilla game.

This isn't a complete game changer, think of it as an in between of Vanilla+ and Modded. This modpack brings some great features into the base game without it losing identity to what the original was supposed to be.

There are plenty of mods of different genres, such as:

**World Generation**:
- Blooming Biosphere and Tectonic, for beautiful world generation.
- Incendium and Nullscape, for revamped nether and end generation.
- Trek and Sunken Spires, for biome-based structures around the world.
- Waystones, for easy travel across the expansive terrain.

**Visuals**
- Visuality, for some smaller particle effects on ores or shiny objects.
- Fresh Moves, Fresh Animations & Fresh Food, for completely overhauled animations.
- Subtle Effects, similarly to Visuality, adds awesome effects to actions in-game.

**Loot and Features**
- Artifacts, for dungeon collectible loot, highly inspired from Terraria.
- Farmer's Delight, for revamping the farming aspect of the game and adds cooking!
- Sophisticated Backpacks, for adding backpacks to the game, a highly requested feature.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
There are many more mods, but this is a simplified list of the current mods. Try it out for yourself! Supports Java 1.21.1 on the Fabric Mod Loader.
